messages:
marta: Quick heads up — saw a weird invoice line for ACCT-789 from the pricing experiment. A cohort should've been billed at 0.6x but looks like full rate applied.
ben (billing): Can you paste the invoice line/id? I don't see an obvious anomaly in the 03/09 run.
marta: Here's the CSV snippet pulled from the invoice export:
```
account_id,product,units,rate,experiment_cohort,invoice_id
ACCT-789,tokens,10000,0.0100,A,INV-20260309-334
ACCT-101,tokens,2500,0.0060,B,INV-20260309-335
```
ajay: That first row should've had rate 0.0060 for cohort A. Looks like the pricing map key mismatch again.
sara: Confirming — platform rolled a mapping change at 03:12 UTC to rename `experiment_id` -> `experiment_group` for the vendor pipeline. Billing still expects `experiment_id`.
ben (billing): billing parser reads `experiment_id` at parse-time. If the field was renamed, the fallback is empty -> default full rate.
billing-bot: :warning: Alert: job parse-pricing (job-20260309-03) exited 500; 12 invoices with missing experiment mapping detected.
marta: Was this only between 03:12 and 03:16 when the mapping drifted?
sara: Yeah the rollout window was 03:10-03:14. Looks like a 4-minute overlap.
ben (billing): I'll run a recon/dry-run to reapply discounts and generate credit estimates. @ajay will need sign-off for credits > $5k.
ajay: Approved for this incident. Please include journal entries and affected invoice list in the ticket.
ben (billing): Running dry-run:
```
python tools/recon_credit.py --from 2026-03-09T03:10:00Z --to 2026-03-09T03:16:00Z --experiment-key experiment_id --dry-run
```
marta: Nice. Once credits queued, can we add a mapping integration test and a quick alert for schema changes?
sara: Yep — I'll open PR against ops/runbooks and add an integration test to the vendor-mapping CI.
billing-bot: Dry-run complete: 14 affected invoices totaling $6,742.00. Manual review required before issuing credits.
ben (billing): Will post the review summary and move to manual credit ops. Thanks all — will update this thread when credits post.
marta: Thanks team. Let's do a short postmortem next Tue. :thumbsup:
